The stored max 30 ft and pull-through rested only on Campendium camper reports, so they are cleared; neither agency source gives a length. Read 2026-10-30

note: USFS Oconee NF (Oconee RD) on the bank of the Oconee River at the head of Lake Oconee, near Scull Shoals, 11.8 mi north of Greensboro on GA-15; shares the area with a boat ramp and picnic area. Tables, tent pads and grills; paved main road. The area is prone to flooding. No generators. Campendium camper reports describe RV use (a 25-ft truck camper; a 21-ft Class B on site 1). --Claude
summary: FS page + a recreation.gov record (10322742) the entry didn't cite: confirmed $5 FCFS, 5 sites, no hookups or drinking water, open year round (rec.gov FCFS season Feb 12-Dec 31); added vault toilet, senior/access 50%, scan-and-pay. Cleared max_rig_ft 30 and pull_through (Campendium only). rec.gov types every site TENT ONLY. Pin within ~65 m of the site centroid (33.7207,-83.2907). Note trimmed of field repeats and the '23-ft EKKO fits' claim.
flags: CRITERIA fit question: recreation.gov's catalog types all 5 sites 'TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC' with no permitted equipment listed, and the rate type is 'WalkInTentsites' ($5). The FS page says only 'Five campsites with tables, tent pads and grills ... Main road through campground is paved' and gives no RV length; the only RV evidence is Campendium camper reports (a 25-ft truck camper; a 21-ft Class B on pull-through site 1). The site coordinates sit along the loop road (33.7206-33.7210, -83.2903 to -83.2911), but the canopy hides the pads on imagery. Possible drop on 'tent only' unless AWH accepts the camper reports.
